## Heads up — this repository cannot merge pull requests

Coop's `main` is a one-way generated mirror of a private monorepo, so there is
nothing for a PR to merge into: the next mirror push would overwrite it.

**Please [open an issue](https://github.com/FastChickensHR/coop/issues/new/choose)
instead** — patches are welcome right in the issue body, and adopted changes
are ported with `Co-authored-by` credit. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
